description: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers, under a threshold of 1e-3, with the x-axis representing the layer index ranging from 0 to 20 and the y-axis representing the sparsity ratio on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8. The plot displays three distinct lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, with an average value of 0.003; an orange dotted line with circular markers representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, with an average value of 0.126; and a green dashed line with circular markers representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, with an average value of 0.080. The blue line remains nearly flat near zero throughout the layers. The orange line starts at approximately 0.8, rapidly declines to about 0.15 by layer 10, and then stabilizes near 0.05 from layer 15 onward. The green line begins at approximately 0.8, decreases more gradually to about 0.05 by layer 10, and then remains relatively stable near 0.05 from layer 15 onward.
